purpose: Eight-sheet workbook with live formulas. Raw observations and numerical integration inputs are constants; derived time series must be formulas.

traffic_inputs.note: Worked example; AZ I-10 westbound detector 78.
Mean delay divided by peak delay.
Input counts assumed per represented lane; do not divide by five.

rate_lookup_rule: For positive speed v, use the last row with speed_lower_mph <= v. First row covers 0 < v < 25. No interpolation. The final row has no finite upper bound. Zero/negative speeds are invalid traffic inputs and must not use this positive-speed table.
rate_table_scope: Passenger-car zero-acceleration rates with original normalized age mixture already aggregated; VSP shown is at the lower speed boundary. Editing rate cells changes lookup-based methods; it does not refit the cubic coefficients.
cubic_coefficient_placement: Small labeled calibrated-input block at top of A method sheet; retain emission input sheet as only speed/VSP/rate table.

shape_helper.location: Visible secondary calculation block below R time series; no extra sheet.
shape_helper.bisection_rule: mid=(lo+hi)/2; if integral(mid)>theta use lo=mid else hi=mid; next step uses prior bounds.
shape_helper.checks: 0<theta<1; integral(initial_upper)<=theta for beta branch; nonnegative analytical minimum arrival weight; nonnegative free-flow time at peak; 5<=vq<vf<=75 for cubic method.

common_time_alignment.meaning: Complete-link trip emissions attributed to recorded five-minute vehicle groups in cumulative-count order; not instantaneous roadway exhaust measured during that clock interval.
common_time_alignment.formula: overlap_ij=MAX(0,MIN(B_i,N_j)-MAX(B_(i-1),N_(j-1))); sum_j overlap_ij*per_vehicle_quantity_j; B is observed cumulative count and N is fitted quadrature cumulative count.
common_time_alignment.efficient_alternative: Build cumulative node counts and cumulative weighted quantities. Piecewise-linearly interpolate each cumulative quantity at observed bin count edges with INDEX/MATCH, then difference adjacent edges. Clamp final cumulative node count to D only for roundoff (<1e-8 at default).
common_time_alignment.M_A_effective_speed: L/(mean_Tfree_i+mean_Tqueue_i); same as R after conservative attribution
common_time_alignment.effective_rate: E_i/H_i; for R this is generally not r0(effective_speed_i) because sub-bin speed groups use separate rates.

provenance.scope: Standalone worked example of 57 bins, not a reproduction of a retained paper episode. Fixed episode boundaries are not redetected when inputs change. Monthly averaging was already completed upstream.
